# Pulse task #2834: Match return-track styling to normal tracks and move insertion into the track context menu

Operation: 96906704275aeb44ae7208d87106528e
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User requests Return tracks visually match normal tracks, while staying pinned in their CURRENT location directly above Main. Preserve current layout/placement in Arrange/Console as applicable; do not move Returns into the ordinary scroll flow, to a new side, or change signal routing. Remove the dedicated 'Returns' section header and the add-return button at its right because they waste space.

Provide Insert Track and Insert Return Track together in the SAME appropriate track-area context menu. Existing normal track header/background menu entry points should make both actions discoverable; preserve other relevant context actions and source/selection behavior. New ordinary track uses existing canonical new-track behavior/default type and user's pending empty-device/non-gray color policies, no unrelated naming/default redesign. New Return uses actual canonical return creation/routing/history. Target insertion according to existing ordinary-track semantics; Returns always remain in the pinned Return section immediately above Main rather than being inserted as ordinary tracks. Menus must work when no Returns exist so removal of the old header/add button never removes the only creation path. Handle legal capacity/refusal visibly and keep keyboard focus/Undo/Redo/save/reopen correct.

Return visual parity includes shared row/header geometry, typography, color/selection/hover styling and applicable volume/device controls. Preserve Return-specific send/routing semantics; do not invent MIDI/audio clip content in a Return merely to match its appearance. Reuse shared track presentation components rather than duplicating a lookalike return renderer. Coordinate #2827/PR431 Alt all-height/header-only/H overview, #2715/merged331 gain slider and #2829/433 shared device shell, but keep this focused PR separate. No regressions in Main, scroll coordinates, header width, normal/Return selection, drag/hits or pinned alignment. If Return controls cannot fit the new header-only compact mode, define compact presentation without invisible overlapping controls; do not restore a redundant section header.

Acceptance: actual rendered normal/Return comparison at normal and compact sizes; no Returns title/add button or empty wasted band; pinned placement before/after scroll with zero/one/multiple Returns; actual right-click menu -> Insert Track/Insert Return creates correct canonical identity/type at correct area; Undo/Redo and failure/cancel restore counts/routing/selection. Source1 owns prior track resizing/shared track UI; queue after current coherent essential Open/returned device-focus fixes, coordinate exact tracks.rs/context_menu hunks with Source6border/Source2icon menu to avoid overlapping writers. One canonical PR, targeted local checks, immutable handoff to sole merger. In Progress while unmerged; Ready for Review only after merge. Root owns native visual acceptance, no live app/data/installation/quit actions.
